edits.old: """Synthetic regressions for the event-orchestrator build-input boundary."""
edits.new: """Synthetic regressions for the event-card-operations build-input boundary."""

# Authority documents are exact pinned inputs, and oversize input must stop
    # before the helper reads its contents.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="event-card-authority-") as temporary:
        fixture = Path(temporary)
        original_root, original_authorities = gate.ROOT, gate.AUTHORITY_FILES
        gate.ROOT = fixture / "bridge/Sts2AgentBridge/successors/event_card_operations_v1"
        document = fixture / "docs/contract.md"
        document.parent.mkdir()
        document.write_bytes(b"accepted contract\n")
        calls = []
        helper = types.SimpleNamespace(reject_links=lambda _: None,
            read_regular=lambda path: calls.append(path) or path.read_bytes())
        gate.AUTHORITY_FILES = {"docs/contract.md": gate.sha(document.read_bytes())}
        try:
            if gate.authority_sources(helper) != {"docs/contract.md": b"accepted contract\n"}:
                raise AssertionError("authority snapshot")
            checks += 1
            document.write_bytes(b"changed contract\n")
            _expect("authority_identity", lambda: gate.authority_sources(helper))
            checks += 1
            calls.clear(); document.write_bytes(b"x" * 65537)
            _expect("authority_size", lambda: gate.authority_sources(helper))
            if calls:
                raise AssertionError("oversized authority was read")
            checks += 1
        finally:
            gate.ROOT, gate.AUTHORITY_FILES = original_root, original_authorities
